Highlighting the religious importance of Navratri, Uniyal stressed the need for decorum. In response, Mehndi asked the minister to step off the stage, igniting discussions about the appropriateness of entertainment at such sacred occasions.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: James and Laureta Gale found a 1901 coal delivery schedule during their renovation of a historic lodging house. Their discovery connects to James's family history with coal delivery in Brooklyn. The couple is transforming the 1880s building into an 11-room guesthouse with modern amenities. They are also preserving original features to honor the building's history. The completed guesthouse will display the coal schedule as a tribute to its past.
title: Couple restoring 1880s Brooklyn house finds 1901 link to family past

description: Saudi Arabia is facing major travel disruptions following a large number of flight cancellations since October 8. Due to attacks by Houthi rebels, Riyadh's airport remains closed and travelers seek alternative routes. Businesses and expatriates are navigating challenges associated with remote working and adjusted travel plans. Major events in the country have been postponed or canceled, impacting international investments.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 2019, Emilia Clarke established SameYou, a charity dedicated to enhancing rehabilitation options for brain injury survivors. With over £3.8 million raised, the initiative has positively impacted more than 1,200 lives. One of its key offerings, NeuroRehabilitation Online, utilizes teletherapy to connect patients with qualified therapists. By focusing on the crucial recovery phase post-hospital, SameYou strives to fill significant gaps in patient care, garnering accolades for its innovative support approaches.
title: Emilia Clarke's charity helps over 1,200 brain injury survivors in 7 years

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Yemen's Iran-linked Houthi rebels announced six military operations targeting Saudi Arabia over the last 48 hours. They claimed to have struck strategic sites including oil facilities and airports, causing significant damage and disruption. This escalation followed reported Saudi airstrikes on Yemeni civilian areas, resulting in numerous casualties. Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree highlighted the Houthis' use of ballistic missiles and drones in these operations.
title: 6 ops in 48 hrs: Houthis claim to strike Saudi airports, oil field & military sites

description: A judge in California has ordered an extensive environmental review for an AI data center proposed in Imperial County. Concerns among local residents center on water resource impacts, emissions, and community disturbances. Developer Sebastian Rucci claims the project will generate jobs and tax income while enhancing AI infrastructure. However, legal disputes persist from the City of Imperial and environmental advocates challenging its progression.

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Manipur's chief minister Y Khemchand Singh condemned the killing of three civilians by suspected militants on Monday. Protesters placed the bodies outside the chief minister's residence, prompting police to intervene. Security forces launched a combing operation to apprehend the assailants, employing sniffer dogs and helicopters for assistance. Violence also erupted a day prior in Thoubal, leaving one person dead during community clashes.
title: Manipur CM condemns killing of civilians, orders tighter security in vulnerable areas

author: PRIYA SRIVASTAVA
description: India's road network has expanded significantly, enhancing travel experiences and connectivity across various regions. A foreign visitor recently traveled over 2,500 km, showcasing the roads from Tamil Nadu to the Himalayas. Improved highways facilitate access to urban centers, pilgrimage sites, and rural areas, making journeys more exciting. Road trips allow travelers to explore lesser-known destinations that are often overlooked by traditional tourist routes.
title: Foreign traveller praises India's roads after 2,500 km journey

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Sarah Beeny has won an eight-year planning battle to retain her Somerset farmhouse, dubbed ‘mini-Downton Abbey’. Bought for £3 million in 2018, the property was extended without planning permission. After her retrospective application was rejected in 2024 and an appeal failed in February 2025, Somerset Council approved a revised proposal allowing the farmhouse to remain.
title: Sarah Beeny wins bid to save farmhouse on £3m estate from demolition

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Morissa Schwartz's experience with her AI assistant revealed an unexpected outcome: an escalated to-do list. Instead of easing her tasks, the assistant generated more reminders and hurdles. To address this, she devised a plan to trim her task list and prioritize clear communication about challenges faced. Ultimately, Schwartz seeks to ensure her AI enhances her productivity rather than complicates it.
title: US entrepreneur used AI to save time; her to-do list grew to 156 tasks

Cuban points to his venture, Cost Plus Drugs, as a prime example of how US manufacturing can lower costs.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a major win for animal welfare, three elderly elephants—Iringa, Toka, and Thika—have journeyed from Toronto Zoo to a sanctuary thanks to Bob Barker's generous funding of nearly $1 million. Their four-day trek concluded at the Performing Animal Welfare Society in California, where they will need time and veterinary expertise to adjust after decades of captivity. This move symbolizes hope for the future of the elephants and advocates alike.
title: Bob Barker spent nearly $1m to move 3 elephants to sanctuary in 2013

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Indian tax authorities are examining whether Pernod Ricard and Diageo wrongly classified bulk Scotch whisky imports for lower tariffs. The investigation follows reduced import duties under the recent India-UK trade pact that came into effect on July 15. Tax inspectors visited Pernod Ricard’s headquarters and searched Diageo’s offices regarding these classifications. Both companies claim they are cooperating fully with the authorities during the investigation.
title: India probes Pernod Ricard, Diageo over Scotch whisky imports under UK trade pact

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: India has decided not to mandate coal imports for power plants due to high international prices and a weaker rupee. Coal stockpiles have reached critically low levels at many power stations, prompting concerns about electricity shortages in the country. Policymakers are focusing on boosting domestic coal production and improving transportation to mitigate the situation.
title: India shelves coal import plan as high global prices, weak rupee raise costs

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An Ohio couple who moved into a friend's house in 2020 and spent $30,000 renovating its kitchen have lost their claim to purchase the property for $215,000. On Wednesday, an appeals court ruled that the renovations did not establish a binding purchase agreement. However, the couple may still receive compensation for the improvements, while the homeowners can pursue eviction proceedings.
title: Ohio couple spent $30,000 on friend's home; court revives eviction bid

Among these were four shining gold medals, with standout performances from Mona Agarwal in shooting and Nishad Kumar in long jump. The success was rounded off with two more gold medals in athletics, placing India fourth overall in medal standings after day one.
title: Asian Para Games Medal Tally: Where does India stand after a bumper 11-medal haul?

The foundation has since reached over 15,000 students across Texas and partnered with various organizations for resources. Their mission continues to focus on underserved communities to ensure equitable access to education.

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: During a routine security check at Jama Masjid Metro station, a passenger attempted to evade the authorities. The Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) noticed suspicious behavior and initiated a chase. After apprehending the individual, CISF personnel discovered a concealed suspicious substance in his undergarment. The passenger claimed to be a non-resident Indian living in Kuala Lumpur. He was subsequently handed over to the police for further investigation.

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The weekend unrest in France led to severe vandalism and looting at Olympique de Marseille and Lille. Marseille's official store on La Canebière was damaged and will remain closed for repairs, while Lille's downtown store also suffered extensive vandalism and is closed until further notice. Both clubs have condemned these acts, expressing solidarity with their employees and supporters as authorities launch cleanup operations and impose restrictions.

author: KANISHK SHARMA
description: BJD chief Naveen Patnaik has written to chief minister Mohan Charan Majhi, questioning the state government’s silence after Andhra Pradesh announced panchayat polls that may cover disputed Kotia villages. He asked whether the “Go Back Andhra” slogan was an election gimmick, as Congress and BJP leaders also weigh in.
title: Odisha vs Andhra over Kotia: Naveen Patnaik turns up heat on Mohan Majhi govt

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: France is currently facing significant protests driven by rising living costs and deteriorating public services. While some residents appear unfazed by the chaos, many cities have witnessed violent rioting and looting. The government has implemented tighter security measures after over 2,400 individuals were arrested during recent unrest. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has suggested localised curfews to curb further violence.

The competition invites fans to rank the greatest Ballon d’Or-winning seasons, with Lionel Messi’s 2012 campaign currently second. Voting closes on October 27, reigniting debate over football’s greatest individual performances and Ronaldo’s enduring legacy.

description: Travis Kelce has denied reports claiming he donated $3.3 million to Foster Love to build a facility for homeless young people in Kansas City. Speaking on his New Heights podcast, the Chiefs star called the claims false and warned fans about AI-generated misinformation. The reported charity announcement has since disappeared from social media and the organisation's website. Kelce directed fans to his nonprofit, 87 & Running, for accurate information about his community work.
title: Travis Kelce calls $3.3M charity donation report “nonsense” after viral claims

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Brittany Mahomes is expanding her business portfolio through partnerships with major brands, including Adidas, Abercrombie & Fitch, Divi and WHOOP. She also helped establish the Kansas City Current, an NWSL team reportedly valued at $325 million. Meanwhile, fitness technology company WHOOP has reached a reported $10.1 billion valuation. Although Brittany’s ventures span fashion, beauty, fitness and sports ownership, her personal net worth and individual investment values have not been publicly disclosed.

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Initially placing third in the women's 1500m T11 event, Rakshita Raju faced disqualification, leading to Ravanni Valasanani clinching the bronze. China showcased exceptional prowess, taking home both the gold and silver medals. Meanwhile, India celebrated a remarkable day, securing medals in several events, highlighted by gold and silver accolades in the women's 1500m T12/T13 and men's javelin throw F46.
title: Why was Rakshitha Raju disqualified despite a faster time as Valasanaini won bronze?

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Amanda Seyfried has rejuvenated a charming 1930s farm in the Catskills, turning it into a cozy family haven and a sanctuary for rescued animals. Not only did she expand the farmhouse, but she also transformed the barn into a delightful guesthouse. As a nonprofit animal rescue, they provide a home to various animals, including horses and dogs.
title: Amanda Seyfried's Catskills farm is now a nonprofit animal rescue sanctuary

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Helen Haines, an independent lawmaker in Australia, was critically injured after being struck by a car. The incident occurred outside her electoral office and is being investigated as an apparent deliberate attack. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese condemned the act and mentioned that a driver was arrested at the scene. There was also a knife found inside the vehicle during the investigation.
title: 'Not accident': Australian PM says MP Helen Haines was hit in 'deliberate act'

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India kicked off the Asian Para Games on a high note, clinching an impressive 11 medals, including four golds. Star athletes such as Mona Agarwal and Nishad Kumar showcased their skills, in shooting and athletics, where they excelled. Athletics stood out with three gold medals and several podium finishes.
title: Asian Para Games: India win 11 medals on Day 1 as Nishad, Mona lead four-gold haul

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Tony Hall, a 62-year-old London resident, faces deportation despite living in the UK for 50 years. His immigration issues stem from a 2001 criminal conviction for conspiracy to rob and possession of a firearm. He has lived under a deportation threat for over 14 years, reporting biweekly to the Home Office. Hall's current status leaves him at risk of homelessness as he relies on his sister for support.
title: Barbados-born man, 62, faces deportation after 50 years in Britain

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Protests in Tirana against Prime Minister Rama have escalated, marked by violent confrontations between crowds and law enforcement. Frustrated by rampant corruption and expensive university tuition, protesters have hurled stones and petrol bombs. In reaction, police have unleashed water cannons and tear gas to control the situation, resulting in multiple injuries on both sides. International organizations are urging for an immediate peaceful resolution to the mounting tensions.
title: Buildings ablaze, petrol bombs hurled at parliament: Albania protests in 10 videos

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Steve Ballmer and his wife, Connie Ballmer, donated $10 million to renovate basketball courts in Los Angeles. The project successfully revamped 350 courts throughout the city, making them more accessible. The Clippers Community Courts project was completed on June 28, 2022, at the Michelle and Barack Obama Sports Center. The renovated courts have served multi-purpose functions during the Covid-19 pandemic, aiding the community.
title: Steve Ballmer gave $10mn to restore LA courts; 350 projects completed 4 years later

author: PALLAVI
description: As the 2027 assembly elections approach, the Punjab Congress is strategically recalibrating its leadership. Pargat Singh steps into the role of party president, supported by Raja Warring and Charanjit Singh Channi in the campaign efforts. Meanwhile, Sachin Pilot hints at Captain Amarinder Singh's unpredictable political future amid his recent critiques of the BJP's policies on Punjab.
title: 'O Captain, My Captain': Should Congress make room for Amarinder Singh again?

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
title: Manipur unrest: 3 killed by militants; locals place bodies in front of CM's house

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The Louvre Museum in Paris has closed its doors temporarily, responding to significant student protests over educational and public service issues. The demonstrations, which have escalated into a wider national movement, also target the rising living costs and decreasing quality in public services. This closure comes on the heels of a major security incident involving a robbery. No updates on the reopening date have been released yet.
title: Exactly 1 year after infamous $102m heist, Louvre Museum in Paris shut amid unrest

author: TOI Education
description: Major Garima Yadav’s journey from an unsuccessful attempt at UPSC Mains to a historic appointment at Raj Bhavan, Lucknow, highlights her determination and career shift. After securing All India Rank 2 in CDS 1 2017, she joined the Indian Army’s Army Service Corps in 2019. She became the first woman Indian Army officer to serve as Aide-de-Camp (ADC) to Uttar Pradesh Governor Anandiben Patel on September 14, 2025, marking a milestone for women in uniform.
title: Major Garima Yadav: Beauty queen who became UP Governor's first woman Army ADC

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Long-range precision strikes are increasingly reshaping military operations and strategies across various countries. The focus on missiles and rockets, especially by Pakistan and India, highlights this evolving dynamic. India has enhanced its conventional strike capabilities, while Pakistan has established the Army Rocket Force Command to improve its response options. Both nations are expanding their military arsenals, reflecting the heightening competition.
title: Beyond air power: How long-range missiles are reshaping the rules of war

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A dispute over a metre-wide strip of land between a Russian Orthodox priest and his neighbour in West Yorkshire has escalated into police complaints, CCTV surveillance and criminal proceedings. The priest was also filmed sprinkling holy water near the disputed fence, which his wife described as an attempt to restore peace. With both households claiming ownership, the matter may now reach a civil court.
title: UK priest filmed blessing fence with holy water amid 1-metre land row

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Nishad Kumar shone brightly at the Asian Para Games, capturing gold in the men's T47 long jump with a leap of 7.11 meters. This victory underscores his talent among India's para-athletes. Meanwhile, Mona Agarwal earned gold in women's 10m air rifle, breaking the Asian Para Games record with 250.0 points. Not far behind, Avani Lekhara achieved silver with 249.6 points, reflecting India's impressive performance on this memorable day.
title: Asian Para Games: Nishad Kumar clinches long jump gold with dominant performance

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: The Free Trade Agreement between India and New Zealand will come into effect on October 20. This agreement allows India to export goods to New Zealand without tariffs, boosting several sectors. India aims to double bilateral trade with New Zealand to NZD 7 billion by 2030. New Zealand exported nearly NZ$2.03 billion worth of goods and services to India in 2025.
title: India-New Zealand FTA effective from Oct 20; targets double trade to $7bn by 2030

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ellen Harrison successfully retained sole ownership of her 432-acre Butler Road Farm after her divorce from Wiley Harrison. The Mississippi Court of Appeals upheld the lower court's ruling classifying the farm as non-marital property, given its purchase before their marriage. Wiley challenged the ruling, claiming marital asset status due to financial connections and alleged contributions. Courts evaluated the evidence and determined that such claims did not prove ownership.
title: Mississippi woman keeps $1.2m farm bought in 1994 as ex loses court appeal

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: India celebrated a monumental success at the 2026 Asian Para Games with an impressive 1-2 finish in the women's 1500m T12/T13 event. Soumya Kumar secured the gold medal, achieving a personal best under the guidance of Bharath Kumar. In a close contest, Radha Venkatesh earned silver with her guide Govind Solanki, showcasing the athletes’ outstanding performances that enhanced India's medal count significantly.
title: Soumya, Radha clinch gold and silver in women’s 1500m T12/T13 at Asian Para Games

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A man sold his residential property and invested the proceeds in another flat in Mumbai. The replacement property was jointly registered in his and his wife's names, with the total investment of around Rs 1.10 crore. He claimed exemption on the capital gains under Section 54 of the Income Tax Act.
title: Sold house, bought Rs 1.10 cr flat with wife; taxman rejects exemption for half amount

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: An extraordinary auction held in Scotland saw the sale of a rare book featuring 56 portraits of Mughal rulers, originally published in Delhi. This remarkable volume, which presents visual interpretations of royal figures, was anticipated to bring in £500 to £800 but astonishingly fetched £16,640. This highlights the growing interest in India's royal history, despite some issues regarding the book's condition.
title: Rare Mughal portrait book sold for £16,640, nearly 21 times estimate

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Studies reveal that the way time is articulated can alter individual perceptions of its length and commitment. For example, the phrase 'two hours and 55 minutes' conveys a sense of extended duration compared to 'three hours', even though it's shorter. This variation in perception plays a crucial role in how we approach goal setting and notice deadlines, indicating that modifying our time expressions could greatly influence our daily choices.
title: Why 2 hours and 55 minutes may feel longer than 3 hours, study finds

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A diamond tiara known as the Mellerio Orléans Tiara will be auctioned on November 11 in Geneva. Originally crafted in 1862 for a royal exhibition, it features a Greek Revival design. After being lost for nearly 69 years, it is expected to fetch between $946,000 and $1.33 million. The tiara was once a wedding gift in 1864 to Marie Isabelle, an Orléanist claimant.
title: French royal tiara missing for nearly 69 years resurfaces, may fetch $1.3m

author: P NAVEEN
description: UK’s Debt Management Office says it found no evidence that a 1917 Indian War Loan, in which a Bhopal merchant invested Rs 35,000, was ever a British government obligation. A Sehore family holding the century-old certificate seeks an account of repayment, estimating its value at several crores today. The DMO didn’t say whether it was repaid.
title: ‘No proof found’: UK to Bhopal family seeking repayment of 1917 war loan

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: A deadly Houthi missile attack on a military training camp in Shabwa province killed at least 20 coalition fighters. The attack also resulted in over two dozen troops wounded, according to military officials. Following the strikes, Yemeni forces reported recapturing territory in Taiz governorate, while Houthi forces continued their offensive. In another incident, a coalition airstrike killed nine people, including children and women, in Saada.
title: Over 30 Yemeni fighters killed as Houthis target military camp with ballistics

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: In a significant move, Pragyan Ojha has taken over as the chairman of the BCCI's Men's Selection Committee following Ajit Agarkar's departure. Joining him is former spinner Ramesh Powar, who brings a wealth of coaching experience. Ojha's appointment comes after Agarkar's successful leadership, which saw India clinch major ICC titles. The Cricket Advisory Committee fully backed Powar during recent discussions, as they aim to build on the team's impressive achievements.
title: Pragyan Ojha replaces Agarkar as selection panel chief; Ramesh joins committee

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Larry Ellison saw a dramatic plunge in his net worth following a sharp drop in Oracle shares, which plummeted around 62%. This decline has sparked worries among investors regarding the company's mounting debt and aggressive push into artificial intelligence. However, Oracle's core business remains robust, driven by strong demand for cloud services, with analysts optimistic about substantial revenue growth in the upcoming years.
title: Larry Ellison loses $6 billion in a day, as AI worries wipe billions from Oracle stock

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Elon Musk's ambitious initiative to allocate one SpaceX share to every child in America by 2027 sparks a myriad of questions about the nuts and bolts of such a plan. Additionally, the complexities of SpaceX being a private entity will require thorough planning to ensure that these shares can be appropriately transferred under existing regulations.

His achievement outshone Prithvi Shaw's former record of 379 runs. Thanks to Sutar's heroic effort, Mizoram declared their innings at 581 for nine against Nagaland, showcasing his remarkable form following a notable T20 Mumbai season.

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: France has experienced significant unrest following protests over rising living costs and public services, resulting in violence and property damage. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu instructed local authorities to consider curfews to prevent further violence while reviewing policing policies.

description: Recently, six exquisite paintings portraying moments from Alexander the Great's life captivated bidders at an auction. Their connection to the Persian literary heritage and the Sultanate era underlines the remarkable blend of art and storytelling within our rich cultural history.

Now, 176 years later, a new biography is examining her life, while her great-great-grandson, Bayo Randle, reflects on her struggles, achievements and complicated relationship with the British monarchy.

Although she faced Aibike Ulanbek Kyzy in the final, who clinched gold with a swift ippon, Kokila's silver illustrates her increasing prowess in the -52kg para-judo category.

The court stressed the importance of timely payment for acknowledged dues and directed the authorities to fulfill all formalities before issuing the complete settlement.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Studies reveal that women with high skills frequently face mistreatment and difficulties in workplace relationships, a challenge less common for men. While male colleagues often receive backing, women are scrutinized through the lens of gender stereotypes. Such biased views can affect women's effectiveness in team settings. It is imperative for organizations to objectively assess abilities, free from gender biases that may influence the support received.
title: Highly intelligent women may face harsher judgment at work than men: Study

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Othalanga, or the suicide tree, flourishes along Kerala's shores, but its perilous fruit contains cerberin, a lethal toxin that can disrupt heart rhythms, leading to potentially fatal outcomes. Between 1989 and 1999, numerous deaths were connected to othalanga poisoning, posing diagnostic challenges for medical professionals due to symptom overlap. Raising awareness about this dangerous plant is crucial for prevention and timely treatment.
title: Kerala’s ‘suicide tree’ linked to hundreds of deaths and forensic mystery

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In the face of displacement from war, Jaafar Atallah crafted an innovative dome-shaped home from local clay for his family. Along with his community, he explored the potential of mud bricks, resulting in sturdier shelters compared to standard tents. This method emerges amidst Gaza's pressing housing crisis, driven by material shortages. Neighbors are also embracing recycled resources, ensuring traditional expertise evolves to tackle the region's housing emergency.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In Pachod village, Sunita Nehare transformed her family's agricultural methods, dramatically boosting crop yields. Despite early challenges with disappointing harvests, she secured management rights of the family land. By integrating advanced farming practices, she not only amplified cotton production but also embraced crop diversification for a sustainable future. With an annual income of around ₹2.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Pierre-Louis Biojout, a San Francisco tech developer, apologized for his zombie game set in Tenderloin. Critics condemned the game, arguing it dehumanized homeless drug users and those struggling with addiction. In response, he removed the game and refunded advertisers, indicating a strong commitment to rectifying the situation. Biojout also donated all game revenue to a drug treatment service focused on recovery.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: For 31 years, Kodak operated a uranium-based research device beneath its Rochester laboratory, using it to examine materials and detect impurities. Installed in 1975 and shut down in 2006, the machine attracted public attention in 2012 because it contained highly enriched uranium. A new Popular Mechanics report explains how the device produced neutrons through nuclear fission but could not sustain a chain reaction independently, making it different from a conventional nuclear reactor.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ashish Sharma and Manali Purohit's dream of running their vegan cafe 'And Bodega' in Fitzroy North, Melbourne, turned tragic when it suffered extensive damage from an arson attack shortly after opening. This incident, linked to a nearby tobacco shop, cost them their life savings and brought additional theft. To recover, they initiated a crowdfunding campaign and are searching for new locations, buoyed by the unwavering support of their community.

The restriction will apply to travellers, campers and businesses, with exemptions for certified, heat-treated wood and certain other wood products. Authorities will focus on public awareness in 2027, while repeat violations could attract fines of $1,000 to $10,000 from 2028.

Additionally, INS Tarkash participated in Exercise IBSAMAR in South Africa while INS Sahyadri engaged with the Russian navy during Exercise INDRA-2026.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A remarkable Qur’an manuscript linked to Mughal emperor Akbar’s library was auctioned for £863,600 in London. It was originally estimated to sell for between £40,000 and £60,000. The manuscript dates back to the late 16th century, showcasing exquisite decorations and multiple commentaries. Its pages contain crucial historical seals and texts that trace its royal journey. The auction was part of Sotheby’s Arts of the Islamic World and India sale events.

description: Residents reported panic and a lack of crowd control, culminating in a tragic stampede. Organizers and volunteers were criticized for their poor management, especially amid heavy rain. Authorities have mandated police to bolster safety and review popular pandals. Political parties are calling for accountability, while many attendees are now wary of crowded events following this incident.
title: 7 held for Kolkata stampede; ‘pandal collapse warning’ triggered run?

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: An audio recording linked to Anil Pandit has emerged, threatening Salman Khan over an apology. Pandit warned against the safety of Khan's family if he does not comply. The threats follow a recent shooting targeting actor Tiger Shroff's car in Mumbai's Juhu area. Shroff was unharmed, while his driver sustained injuries during the incident. Police are investigating the claims made in the audio and social media posts.
title: 'Apologise to Lawrence Bishnoi': After Tiger Shroff attack, fresh warning to Salman

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Tiger Shroff shooting: Videos piece together moments before, during and after attack

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices have seen a downturn due to US President Donald Trump's decision to lift sanctions on Russia, causing worries about supply stability. Brent crude is now at $108.3 per barrel, while West Texas Intermediate has decreased to $101.2 per barrel. Heightened security risks in the Middle East and the ongoing uncertainty of US-Iran talks are adding to the market's instability.
title: Oil prices ease as Trump waives Russia sanctions, Middle East risks persist

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's film 'Ranabaali' had a marginal increase in box office collections on Sunday. The film earned Rs 7.50 crore net in India, bringing its three-day total to Rs 24.05 crore. 'Ranabaali' had a worldwide gross collection of Rs 36.90 crore, with significant contributions from overseas markets. Rashmika Mandanna compared Deverakonda's performance to Allu Arjun in 'Pushpa 2' during a recent press event.
title: 'Ranabaali' collection: Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna's film earns Rs 7.50 cr

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: On October 25, the Pakistan Cricket Board will honor breast cancer awareness during an ODI match. Players will don vibrant pink kits, while the England team and others show support by wearing pink ribbons. The stadium will feature pink-branded stumps and awareness messages on screens, emphasizing the critical role of early detection and timely treatment during Breast Cancer Awareness Month, commonly referred to as Pinktober.
title: Why Pakistan will wear pink jerseys in ODI tri-series against England

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Accenture is reportedly exploring the sale of its China division, potentially worth $1.5 billion. This strategic move comes amid unsolicited inquiries, aiming to prioritize growth markets. Fluctuations in Accenture's stock highlight concerns over its artificial intelligence strategies and automation efforts. The planned divestiture could facilitate reinvestment in long-term goals, particularly in bolstering AI capabilities. Analysts express a positive outlook on future prospects within Accenture's extensive market presence.
title: Accenture may exit China after unsolicited offer as investors debate its AI future

description: On Sunday evening, actor Tiger Shroff was involved in a violent incident in Juhu while leaving an event. Unidentified assailants on a motorcycle opened fire, injuring his driver Firdaus and a nearby fan. The shooting occurred near a police station, raising concerns about local law and order. Both Shroff and his driver were taken to Nanoavati Hospital following the incident.
title: 3 men fire 7 shots, a gun jams in between: New video captures attack on Tiger Shroff

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Donald Trump has announced plans to close Washington’s 106-year-old East Potomac Golf Links for 15 months from November 15 for a redevelopment designed by renowned architect Tom Fazio. The announcement comes amid a legal battle, with a federal judge halting tree removal. Trump says the revamped public course could host major international golf tournaments.
title: Trump to redevelop 106-year-old DC golf course, plans 15-month closure

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Following a lengthy three-year investigation, Heather Ann Textor, a legal secretary, has been taken into custody for alleged fraudulent activities. She is accused of forging court documents and misappropriating client funds intended for legal fees. The investigation was sparked when a local resident submitted a counterfeit expungement petition to the state police, leading to further scrutiny of suspicious transactions that funneled money into Textor's personal accounts.
title: Paid to clear records, got fake orders; Indiana staffer charged

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Rajinikanth's new film, 'Jailer 2', is enjoying a fantastic run at the box office, raking in Rs 55.85 crore net in India on its fourth day alone. This marks an impressive 18.2% increase from Saturday, leading to a total net collection of Rs 199.90 crore in India and a worldwide gross of Rs 424.25 crore.
title: Jailer 2 earns Rs 56 cr on Day 4, crosses Rs 424 cr worldwide

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Tiger Shroff was escorted home under police protection after unidentified attackers fired three shots at his car in Mumbai’s Juhu on Sunday, October 18, 2026, as he returned from football. He was unhurt, though tape on his hand drew attention. His driver was injured. A message linked to the Bishnoi gang claimed responsibility; police haven’t verified it.
title: Tiger Shroff covers face, reaches home under police protection after Juhu firing

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In June 2016, John Oliver's show made headlines by acquiring nearly $15 million of unpaid medical debt for only $60,000. This debt was funneled through a newly established company aimed at giving it away. Rather than pursuing payments, the debt was assigned to a nonprofit dedicated to alleviating medical debt, drawing attention to critical flaws in the American healthcare system.
title: John Oliver bought $15M in medical debt for $60k, then erased it

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Carolynne Hunter has initiated a fundraising campaign to assist families struggling with high energy bills related to medical equipment. After receiving a generous donation from actress Kate Winslet, Hunter aims to provide financial aid this Christmas. The campaign supports Children's Hospices Across Scotland, which assists families caring for children with health challenges. Hunter emphasizes the need for social tariffs to alleviate energy costs for those with medical equipment.
title: Kate Winslet's £17k gift sparks fundraiser for families

description: The match against Sri Lanka was his 355th in international cricket. However, he fell short of a half-century, getting out for 45 to Pavan Rathnayake off Eshan Malinga.

description: Ravi Shastri shared his enthusiastic endorsement of Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Mohammed Shami's selection for the T20I squad. author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: John Legend has pledged $500,000 to revitalize a former high school auditorium in Springfield, Ohio, transforming it into the John Legend Theater. This venue now hosts youth concerts and community events, reflecting Legend's personal ties to the space, where he performed as a child. With state-of-the-art production facilities, the theater fosters arts education, empowering local students to showcase their talents since its grand opening.
title: John Legend’s $500,000 gift helped restore 680-seat theatre in Ohio hometown

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Cassandra Henderson has returned to her old school, now transformed into Dillard School Senior Apartments. After sitting empty for twenty years, this historic building has emerged as a vital haven for seniors, featuring thoughtful designs and amenities tailored to their needs. Originally a cornerstone for Black education, this repurposing highlights how adaptive reuse can effectively tackle housing shortages.
title: North Carolina school becomes 53 senior apartments; former student moves back
